_doc: Single source of truth for the studio's motion grammar. The names and control points follow motion.dev (framer-motion's named easings) so any recipe copied from https://motion.dev/docs can be typed straight into engine K (templates/render/lib/motion.js) or engine P (templates/procedural-reels/motion.py). tests/test_motion.py fails if either engine drifts from this file.

brand._doc: Medo's locked motion timing (brand/BRAND.md §6). These are the defaults the engines use when a scene does not ask for something else.
